restaurantName: Found Restaurant & Bar - The Lost Property Hotel
bio: Freshly foraged food found in local London markets and exotic libations concocted by inquisitive mixologists. At Found Bar & Restaurant, you can enjoy a truly unique Afternoon Tea experience.  A stylish restaurant and bar in St Paul’s, offering delicious French inspired cuisine in a stunning venue, Afternoon Tea is served in the Found Restaurant & Bar of the hotel.  Experience a scrumptious Afternoon Tea at Found Restaurant & Bar at the Lost Property Hotel - Curio by Hilton. The luxurious interior creates the ideal relaxing environment to enjoy the experience. The menu includes a classic Afternoon Tea with a selection of sandwiches, scones and jam along with homemade cakes. Upgrade yourself to a Deluxe Afternoon Tea with a glass of champagne for £49.50pp, or opt for Bottomless Afternoon Tea with unlimited champagne for £79.50pp.  Located just next to St Paul's Cathedral. Closer to both Blackfriars station as well as St Pauls underground station. Please note that Lost Property Hotel require a deposit of £10 per person to secure your Afternoon Tea booking. A member of the team will be in touch with you to arrange the payment after they have received your booking.
